name: TactiCon
blurb: Colorado tabletop gaming convention with 24-hour board, card and roleplaying game play at the Hyatt Regency Aurora-Denver.
notes: The given url (tacticon.org) is now a dead HostGator parked page ('please configure your name servers') -- not TactiCon's site at all. tacticon.games is a different, unrelated 'TactiCon': a digital Steam convention for tactics video games hosted by Hooded Horse & Firesquid. The real Colorado tabletop/RPG TactiCon ('GenghisCon's younger sibling') is organized by Gamer Girl Games, the same company behind GenghisCon, both run at the Hyatt Regency Aurora-Denver Conference Center. gamergirlgames.com/tacticon-2026/ confirms the most recent edition ran August 27-30, 2026 (already past as of this 2026-10-05 check, so recorded as "last"); no 2027 TactiCon dates have been announced anywhere yet (not on gamergirlgames.com, tabletop.events, or Facebook facebook.com/tacticoncolorado), so editions is empty. Used the organizer's site root as url since the dated /tacticon-2026/ page will go stale. Id kept as given (matches the convention's own name) despite the url correction. Cover: TactiCon-specific logo from gamergirlgames.com/tacticon-2026/ (logo:0); no wide key-art banner was available. Guests: no guest/author list found on the organizer's TactiCon pages.
